overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the February 7 and 28 executive session notices were adequately specific, and the February 21 notice raised no issue because the Board never entered executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the February 7 and February 28 notices gave executive session topics without enough detail about the bodies and matters to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: The discussions on February 7 and February 28 fit squarely within the ambits of either Purpose 2 or Purpose 3.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the February 21 notice's executive session topic was not sufficiently specific, though the Board never entered executive session that night.
allegations.key_passage: With respect to the February 21 notice, we find no violation regarding the sufficiency of the executive session topic listed on that notice because the Board did not convene in executive session.
